mapper.select: SELECT e.primary_org_name, e.position_name, p.nickname, p.avatar_object_key, p.avatar_url FROM sys_employee e LEFT JOIN sys_wechat_profile p ON p.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_wechat_profile (id, employee_id, external_identity_id, nickname, avatar_object_key, profile_updated_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{id}, #{employeeId}, i.id, #{nickname}, #{avatarObjectKey}, #{now}, #{now}, #{now} FROM sys_external_identity i WHERE i.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND i.provider_type = 'WECHAT' AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.select: SELECT avatar_object_key FROM sys_wechat_profile WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} FOR UPDATE
